oe_cw_can_begin = {
    tag = BYZ
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_begun }
    has_regent = yes
    has_variable = oe_nf_andronikos_iii_died
    current_date >= 1337.1.1
    current_date < 1350.1.1
    exists = character:byz_john_kantakouzenos
    character:byz_john_kantakouzenos = { is_alive = yes owner = c:BYZ }
    # Only the historical regency: John V's (not a later child emperor's). While a regent governs, the child is
    # still the heir in the engine, not the ruler (r4 test), so either counts.
    exists = character:byz_john_v_palaiologos
    character:byz_john_v_palaiologos = { OR = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ is_heir_of = c:BYZ } }
}
# BYZ scope. Kantakouzenos can raise Thrace: no other civil war, and the empire still holds Thracian countryside.
oe_cw_war_possible = {
    in_civil_war = no
    exists = character:byz_john_kantakouzenos
    character:byz_john_kantakouzenos = { is_alive = yes }
    any_owned_location = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 is_capital = no NOT = { this = location:edirne } NOT = { this = location:komotini } }
}
# Location scope: one of the ten cities of the war.
oe_cw_key_city = {
    OR = { this = location:constantinople this = location:thessaloniki this = location:edirne this = location:demotica this = location:serres this = location:veria this = location:silivri this = location:plovdiv this = location:komotini this = location:kavala }
}
